description: This file defines functions and configurations for setting up, initializing, and tearing down a 3G network interface using shell scripting. It includes logic for handling different network services, device setup, and communication scripts.

methods.name: proto_3g_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the 3G protocol configuration by setting parameters like device, apn, service, etc.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 3G network interface, handling device link, PIN code, service type, and establishing a connection.

methods.name: proto_3g_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the 3G network interface by killing associated processes.
